web.agent.caps.fmt_help:
📖 Capability Format

A capability is a JSON array; each capability has name, description, fields (parameter list). Each parameter has name, type (string/number/boolean), description, required (optional).

[
  {
    "name": "chat",
    "description": "Chat freely with user",
    "fields": [
      {"name": "message", "type": "string", "description": "User input", "required": true}
    ]
  }
]

web.trusted_remote.remote_execution_help: VOKO does not change Codex execution or permissions. Pending remote tasks are not executed while this is disabled.
web.trusted_remote.codex_native_help: VOKO passes raw input only. Tools, sandboxing, networking, and approvals remain controlled by native Codex settings.
web.trusted_remote.security_text: Login requires owner email verification. A device session lasts up to 30 days and expires after 7 idle days. Disconnecting a device immediately removes access to all owner Agents. The trusted remote entry is only for private owner-Agent conversations, not group chat or approvals.
